title: How to process a customer refund (Harbor Supply back office)
note: Simulated demo clip. Narration is a synthetic voice (Kokoro TTS, voice af_heart). Step times and target boxes in clip-truth.json are ground truth for eval.

steps.say: This is how to process a customer refund in the Harbor Supply back office.
First, open Orders from the left menu.
Search for the order number. Here it is H S one zero four two one.
Open the order and check that the status says Delivered. We only refund delivered orders, because a shipped order can still be stopped by the courier.
steps.reason: a shipped order can still be stopped by the courier

steps.say: Next, click Check stock. We check stock first because the returned item has to be back on the shelf before we pay anything out.
steps.reason: the returned item has to be back on the shelf before paying out

steps.say: Choose a refund reason from the list.
Type the order number again to confirm. Refunds cannot be reversed, so this second check stops mistakes on the wrong order.
steps.reason: refunds cannot be reversed, so the second check stops mistakes

steps.say: This order is above five hundred dollars, so a supervisor types their code here. Any refund above five hundred dollars needs a supervisor code.
Click Confirm refund. A green message shows when the refund is issued.
That is it. If the item is out of stock, stop and ask the warehouse team first.
